The right side shows the interior mechanism holding a stack of papers or dividers with colored edges (red, yellow). The binder appears to be resting on a light-colored surface.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interface between the metal rings and the papers. AI often fails to render the holes in the paper aligning with the rings. Check if the label text is gibberish or legible. Determine if the blur is natural depth-of-field or AI smearing.
